posts.caption:
Six people who learned in six completely different ways. One of them learns the way you do.

da Vinci filled thousands of notebooks and finished almost nothing he started. Nightingale counted every death on the ward and drew the chart that changed medicine. Mozart heard a piece once, aged fourteen, and wrote the whole thing out from memory. Darwin said he had no great quickness of apprehension - then spent twenty years on one idea.

The quiz works out which one you are, and the teaching adapts to it. Link in bio.
